product_family: Cloud-based e-commerce platform with Starter and Pro subscription plans, plus self-hosted options. Includes HIPAA-Ready extension for healthcare organizations. Core capabilities: payment processing, inventory management, customer data management, order fulfillment.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Availability, and Confidentiality)
certifications.proof_quote: Adobe Commerce on Cloud holds SOC 2–Type 2 (Security + HIPAA) certification

certifications.name: ISO 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: Adobe's Information Security Management System (ISMS) is certified under the ISO/IEC 27001 globally recognized standard

certifications.name: ISO 27017:2015 (Cloud Security)
certifications.proof_quote: Adobe Commerce maintains ISO 27017:2015 certification as part of their cloud security controls framework

certifications.name: ISO 27018:2019 (Personal Data Protection in Cloud)
certifications.proof_quote: Adobe Commerce maintains ISO 27018:2019 certification for personal data protection in cloud services

certifications.name: PCI DSS 4.0
certifications.proof_quote: Adobe Commerce on Cloud is a PCI DSS 4.0 compliant service provider, ensuring secure handling of payment card data

certifications.name: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation)
certifications.proof_quote: Adobe provides GDPR-compliant tools, documentation, and guidance for merchants to meet their GDPR obligations, but GDPR itself is not a certification—it is a regulation. Merchants remain responsible for their GDPR compliance implementation.

certifications.name: HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act)
certifications.proof_quote: Adobe Commerce offers HIPAA-Ready services (via magento/hipaa-ee extension) which enable healthcare compliance, but Adobe is not HIPAA-certified. Covered entities must enter into a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) with Adobe for HIPAA liability coverage.

certifications.name: FedRAMP (Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program)
certifications.proof_quote: Adobe Cloud Services received FedRAMP Authorization in July 2015 for certain products like Adobe Experience Manager and Adobe Connect. No public evidence of FedRAMP certification specifically for Adobe Commerce.

privacy.ai_training_note: Adobe explicitly states it does not train generative AI on customer content. Adobe Firefly (generative AI) is trained only on Adobe Stock (licensed content) and public domain content. Customers retain control and can opt out of content analysis for product improvement. Minors and business account users are automatically opted out.
privacy.data_region: Multi-region support: EU (EU-3, EU-5, EU-6), US, and APAC regions. Specific locations provisioned at contract signing.

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: AES 256-bit encryption for all stored data

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: TLS 1.2 or greater (HTTPS) for all data in transit

security.name: Web Application Firewall (WAF)
security.value: Managed protection against SQL injection, Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), and OWASP Top Ten threats

security.name: DDoS Protection
security.value: Layer 3 and Layer 4 DDoS protection against SYN floods, UDP floods, and TCP-level attacks

security.name: API Security
security.value: API Mesh encrypts secrets using AES-256 encryption

security.name: SSL/TLS Certificates
security.value: Domain-Validated Let's Encrypt SSL/TLS certificate provided by Adobe for all cloud environments

products.name: Adobe Commerce Cloud - Starter Plan
products.data_scope: Development, staging, and testing environments with multiple integration environments
products.notes: Entry-level cloud offering for smaller projects. Supports up to 4 environments. Includes Adobe-managed infrastructure, automated backups, and security updates.

products.name: Adobe Commerce Cloud - Pro Plan
products.data_scope: Production-grade e-commerce with advanced staging and integration capabilities
products.notes: Enterprise-tier cloud offering. Enhanced features beyond Starter. Full PCI DSS 4.0 compliance at platform level. Customers responsible for compliance of custom code/extensions.

products.name: Adobe Commerce (Self-Hosted)
products.notes: Legacy option: Magento Open Source or Adobe Commerce perpetual license. Customer is fully responsible for security, compliance, and infrastructure.

products.name: Adobe Commerce HIPAA-Ready
products.data_scope: Healthcare-compliant e-commerce for organizations handling Protected Health Information (PHI)
products.notes: Requires purchase of healthcare add-on (magento/hipaa-ee extension) and deployment on Adobe Commerce Cloud 2.4.6-p3 or later. Requires Business Associate Agreement (BAA). Enhanced audit logging for PHI tracking. Disabled features: guest checkout, newsletters, SendGrid integration.

compare.pricing_model: SaaS subscription (Starter/Pro plans with per-project fees) or perpetual license (self-hosted Magento/Adobe Commerce)
compare.data_residency: Multi-region: EU (EU-3, EU-5, EU-6), US, and APAC. Region selection at contract signing.

flags: HIPAA-Ready is NOT HIPAA-certified: Adobe offers HIPAA-ready infrastructure and a healthcare add-on, but certification is not held by Adobe. Healthcare organizations must execute a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) with Adobe and ensure proper configuration to achieve HIPAA compliance.

GDPR is not a certification: Adobe provides GDPR-compliant tools and documentation, but merchants remain responsible for implementing GDPR requirements (consent, data subject rights, data processing). No formal GDPR certification is held.

Shared responsibility model: Adobe maintains SOC 2, PCI DSS, and ISO compliance for platform and infrastructure. Merchants are responsible for PCI compliance of custom code, extensions, and custom integrations. This is clearly documented but important to verify at implementation.
FedRAMP: While Adobe has FedRAMP Authorization for some products (AEM, Connect), no specific FedRAMP certification is documented for Adobe Commerce. Government customers should verify independently.
Customer support access: Adobe Support may access customer data to provide support, but authorization is required from the Adobe Commerce account holder via account privacy settings.
